notes: Raw prompt text stays under data/raw-eval/ (gitignored) and is never written to reports or console output.
The held-out test split (data/raw/test.parquet) is not read by this evaluation.
Evaluation scoring uses the frozen checkpoint models/deberta-v3-small at threshold 0.90 with gateway policy band_v1.
